blocks.text:
# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 743
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/743
- **Title**: gh-742 CliAgent: 'response.md missing — resetting for retry' then exits success with NO retry (gh-350)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-742` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +205
- **Deletions**: -62
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:07:06Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:23:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

<details>
<summary>Flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CLI[CLI agent interrupted] --> P[post Development Interrupted comment]
  P --> R[move ticket to Ready For Development]
  R --> L[remove WIP label]
  L --> T[throwInterruptedReset — marked error]
  T --> RED[workflow run RED]
  RED -->|SM re-dispatch on next tick| RETRY[dev leg retry]
```
</details>

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 743
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/743
- **Title**: gh-742 CliAgent: 'response.md missing — resetting for retry' then exits success with NO retry (gh-350)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-742` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +205
- **Deletions**: -62
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:07:06Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:23:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

<details>
<summary>Flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CLI[CLI agent interrupted] --> P[post Development Interrupted comment]
  P --> R[move ticket to Ready For Development]
  R --> L[remove WIP label]
  L --> T[throwInterruptedReset — marked error]
  T --> RED[workflow run RED]
  RED -->|SM re-dispatch on next tick| RETRY[dev leg retry]
```
</details>

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions

blocks.text:
# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +205
- **Deletions**: -62
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:07:06Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:23:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

<details>
<summary>Flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CLI[CLI agent interrupted] --> P[post Development Interrupted comment]
  P --> R[move ticket to Ready For Development]
  R --> L[remove WIP label]
  L --> T[throwInterruptedReset — marked error]
  T --> RED[workflow run RED]
  RED -->|SM re-dispatch on next tick| RETRY[dev leg retry]
```
</details>

# pr-743: gh-742 CliAgent: 'response.md missing — resetting for retry' then exits success with NO retry (gh-350)

## Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

<details>
<summary>Flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CLI[CLI agent interrupted] --> P[post Development Interrupted comment]
  P --> R[move ticket to Ready For Development]
  R --> L[remove WIP label]
  L --> T[throwInterruptedReset — marked error]
  T --> RED[workflow run RED]
  RED -->|SM re-dispatch on next tick| RETRY[dev leg retry]
```
</details>

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

- **Title**: gh-742 CliAgent: 'response.md missing — resetting for retry' then exits success with NO retry (gh-350)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-742` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +205
- **Deletions**: -62
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:07:06Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:23:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

<details>
<summary>Flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CLI[CLI agent interrupted] --> P[post Development Interrupted comment]
  P --> R[move ticket to Ready For Development]
  R --> L[remove WIP label]
  L --> T[throwInterruptedReset — marked error]
  T --> RED[workflow run RED]
  RED -->|SM re-dispatch on next tick| RETRY[dev leg retry]
```

# pr-743: gh-742 CliAgent: 'response.md missing — resetting for retry' then exits success with NO retry (gh-350)

## Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

<summary>Flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CLI[CLI agent interrupted] --> P[post Development Interrupted comment]
  P --> R[move ticket to Ready For Development]
  R --> L[remove WIP label]
  L --> T[throwInterruptedReset — marked error]
  T --> RED[workflow run RED]
  RED -->|SM re-dispatch on next tick| RETRY[dev leg retry]
```
</details>

blocks.text:
# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions

blocks.text:
# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

- **PR #**: 743
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/743
- **Title**: gh-742 CliAgent: 'response.md missing — resetting for retry' then exits success with NO retry (gh-350)
- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open

- **Additions**: +205
- **Deletions**: -62
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:07:06Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:23:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)

- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed

```

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

flowchart TD

```

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

- **PR #**: 743

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-742` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +205
- **Deletions**: -62
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:07:06Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:23:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

<summary>Flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CLI[CLI agent interrupted] --> P[post Development Interrupted comment]
  P --> R[move ticket to Ready For Development]
  R --> L[remove WIP label]
  L --> T[throwInterruptedReset — marked error]
  T --> RED[workflow run RED]
  RED -->|SM re-dispatch on next tick| RETRY[dev leg retry]
```
</details>

blocks.text:
# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:23:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

<summary>Flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CLI[CLI agent interrupted] --> P[post Development Interrupted comment]
  P --> R[move ticket to Ready For Development]
  R --> L[remove WIP label]
  L --> T[throwInterruptedReset — marked error]
  T --> RED[workflow run RED]
  RED -->|SM re-dispatch on next tick| RETRY[dev leg retry]
```
</details>

blocks.text:
# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-05):

`throwInterruptedReset` here is a byte-for-byte copy of the one in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (same message, same `interruptedReset` marker). The doc comment justifies the split ("the bug flow's interrupted path lives before the delegation point"), but `developBugAndCreatePR` already `require`s `developTicketAndCreatePR` — consider exporting the helper from it:

```javascript
// developTicketAndCreatePR.js
module.exports = { action: action, throwInterruptedReset: throwInterruptedReset };
```

```javascript
// developBugAndCreatePR.js
var developTicket = require('./developTicketAndCreatePR.js');
// ...
developTicket.throwInterruptedReset(ticketKeyForCheck);
```

This keeps the marker/message contract in one place so the two implementations can't drift apart on a future edit. Non-blocking — the current duplication is documented and works.

---

### Thread 2 — `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-05):
💡 **SUGGESTION: interrupted-reset can now loop indefinitely — consider a circuit-breaker**

With gh-742 the interrupted path is: comment + reset to Ready For Development + RED run → SM re-dispatch → retry. blocks.text:
# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)

- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed

dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

# Copilot Instructions — dmtools-agents

## Architecture

This is a **generic agents repository** (typically used as a git submodule at `agents/` inside product repos). It orchestrates AI-driven Agile delivery via [dmtools](https://github.com/nicku/dmtools) — a Java tool that provides a GraalJS runtime for agent scripts.

### Execution model

1. **SM Agent** (`sm.json` → `js/smAgent.js`) runs on a cron schedule, queries Jira via JQL rules, and dispatches specialized agents by triggering GitHub Actions workflows.
2. **Agent configs** (root `*.json` files) define individual agent jobs. Three job types exist:
   - `Teammate` — CLI-based agent (prepares context → runs AI CLI → post-processes result)
   - `JSRunner` — pure GraalJS logic executed inside dmtools (no AI CLI)
   - `TestCasesGenerator` — dmtools-native job for test case generation
3. **Project config** lives in the target repo at `.dmtools/config.js`, never here. This repo stays project-agnostic.

### Key layers

| Layer | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| SM rules | `sm.json`, `sm_merge.json` | JQL-based ticket routing |
| Agent configs | root `*.json` | Job definitions (type, params, actions) |
| JS runtime scripts | `js/` | Pre/post actions, orchestration logic |
| Shared helpers | `js/common/` | SCM abstraction, Jira helpers, PR logic |
| Config system | `js/configLoader.js` + `js/config.js` | Discovery, merging, defaults |
| Prompts | `prompts/` | Markdown entry prompts for CLI agents |
| Instructions | `instructions/` | Reusable instruction packs (review, dev, rework, platform, tracker, scm) |
| Setup scripts | `setup/` | Shell scripts for CI environment setup |

## GraalJS Constraints

All `js/` runtime code executes in **dmtools GraalJS**, not Node.js.

- Use `var` declarations and plain functions (no `let`/`const`, no arrow functions, no async/await, no template literals).
- No Node.js APIs: no `fs`, `path`, `process`, `Buffer`, `child_process`, no npm packages.
- No browser APIs: no `fetch`, `window`, `document`.
- Use dmtools globals: `jira_*`, `github_*`, `ado_*`, `file_read`, `file_write`, `cli_execute_command`.
- Local `require('./module.js')` works only for files within this repo.
- Keep data structures JSON-safe.

## Running Tests

Tests run **standalone** inside dmtools GraalJS via the custom test runner. The repo is independent — no parent repo or submodule mount needed.

```bash
# Run from the dmtools-agents repo root
cd dmtools-agents

# All tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# Single test suite
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json
```

Each `run_*.json` specifies which test files to load. Tests use `loadModule()` with mock injection — see `js/unit-tests/testRunner.js` for the framework API (`test()`, `suite()`, `assert.*`, `loadModule()`, `makeRequire()`).

### Writing tests for new logic

**All new JS logic must be covered by unit tests before committing.**

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 743
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/743
- **Title**: gh-742 CliAgent: 'response.md missing — resetting for retry' then exits success with NO retry (gh-350)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-742` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +205
- **Deletions**: -62
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:07:06Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:23:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #742
### What changed
The interrupted-agent "reset for retry" paths in the dev post-actions now fail the run loudly (thrown, marked error) after posting the interrupted comment and resetting the ticket, instead of returning `{ success: true }` — fixing both gh-742 defects with one change: the leg is no longer a green no-PR dead letter, and the workflow wrapper never reaches its review-arming step on a failed leg.

### Key decisions
- Followed the established gh-683 / gh-729 dead-letter pattern: new `throwInterruptedReset()` helper throws an `interruptedReset`-marked error after the comment + Ready For Development reset + WIP-label cleanup already happened — the failure stays retryable, only the run conclusion changes (green → red)
- Applied to all three interrupted paths: both sites in `js/developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (no-changes-no-response, and the live gh-350 case "response.md missing after commit") and the pre-delegation interrupted path in `js/developBugAndCreatePR.js`
- Outer catch blocks rethrow the marker (no double-reset); the bug wrapper propagates the marker from the delegated story flow too
- Retry semantics unchanged: ticket is still moved to Ready For Development and WIP labels removed before the throw, so the SM re-dispatch path is intact

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developTicketAndCreatePR.json   # 18 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_developBugAndCreatePR.json      # 8 passed
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                        # 1599 passed, 0 failed
```

<details>
<summary>Flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  CLI[CLI agent interrupted] --> P[post Development Interrupted comment]
  P --> R[move ticket to Ready For Development]
  R --> L[remove WIP label]
  L --> T[throwInterruptedReset — marked error]
  T --> RED[workflow run RED]
  RED -->|SM re-dispatch on next tick| RETRY[dev leg retry]
```
</details>
